one_liner: Pipedrive is a sales CRM with a broad, publicly documented API and a vendor-hosted MCP connection.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 is recommended for public apps; API-token integration is for private apps only.

access.notes: A no-credit-card, 14-day trial provides full access, and an API token can be obtained from the web app. Developers can request a sandbox, but its price and approval requirements are not established. Public Marketplace apps require approval; private apps do not.

api.notes: Pipedrive says its API and extension points cover the majority of core product functionality.

verdict.rationale: A developer can obtain an API token during a 14-day trial and use the documented REST API. A developer sandbox is offered, but its price and approval requirements are not established, so the evidenced credential path is trial-limited.

evidence.quote: You can create an app using either OAuth 2.0 (mandatory for all apps) or API token integration (private apps only).
The recommended authorization protocol for all public apps available in the Pipedrive Marketplace is the industry-standard OAuth 2.0 protocol.
Free 14-day trial. Full access. No credit card required.

name: Pipedrive

verification.note: The quotes document OAuth 2.0 and API-token integration, and explicitly recommend OAuth 2.0 for public Marketplace apps.

The no-credit-card, full-access 14-day trial and the in-app API-token instructions support a self-serve trial credential path. The quotes do not identify which type of app needs approval, so the note's public-versus-private approval distinction is not established.
The publicly cited API reference identifies a RESTful API and says it covers the majority of core functionality; nothing contradicts the broad-breadth estimate.
Pipedrive describes the connection as official and built and maintained by Pipedrive.
The quote is from a Composio Pipedrive toolkit page.

Trial-based self-serve credentials and a documented, broad REST API support buildable_with_caveats. The trial limit is a notable constraint; because there is no trial-specific main_blocker value, other is appropriate.
